description: Services Completed for ExchangeRebel — the machine-readable twin of the public proof-of-work board at https://exchangerebel.com/services-completed : what the fleet's metered services have actually delivered, read live from each service's own published counters (reputation-integrity verdict: paid checks and attestations; observability check: paid reports; prompt-injection verdict: paid scans and verdict totals; agent-readiness audit: paid audits — each with distinct payers and today's free pre-checks), plus the 402 Open Book's record (posts, cards, settled paid posts, outside USDC settled) and the list of services that are serving but not metered. FREE — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/services-completed.json.
